entities.title: Repository documents
entities.summary: The procedures that apply to every game rather than to one of them.
entities.purpose: Holds docs/database-migrations.md: how a game's database changes (a fresh database from worker/schema.sql, the live one only through worker/migrations/), how a migration is applied to production by hand, and how a pull request acknowledges it so the Database migration check and the deploy gate let it through.
boundaries: Each game's own documents live in that game's folder (games/chess/docs, games/dictator/docs, games/lodestar/docs), not here.
The gate that enforces the procedure is .github/scripts/migration-gate.sh, which reads this document's path.
